proof: `CAPITAL PROJECT FUNDS FY 2011`, PDF page 71 of the FY2011 annual town report (printed folio 68). ONE table, 34 figure rows under six article headings, against a printed `GRAND TOTAL` row. THE PRINTED COLUMN HEADER, VERBATIM AND IN ORDER (rule 13b.4): `ART #/YR` | `PURPOSE` | `APPROPRIATED FORWARD` | `EXPENDED/ENCUMBERED/ TRANSFERRED` | `BALANCE`. The `fwd` tokens printed to the right of the first money column are part of that column's label, not figures. WHAT PROVES IT, and there are two independent proofs: (1) all THREE money columns foot to the printed GRAND TOTAL to the cent and with no tolerance -- 2,561,789.31, 750,290.55 and 1,811,498.76; (2) every one of the 34 rows closes on the identity the table states about itself, appropriated forward less expended/encumbered/transferred equals balance. One wrong digit anywhere breaks both. THE SIGN CONVENTION IS THE DOCUMENT'S AND IS FIXED BY THE TOTAL: four rows print the expended cell in PARENTHESES -- ($744.00), ($5.00), ($590.80) and ($39.24) -- and are recorded negative. Read as positives the column would foot to 753,048.63 against a printed 750,290.55, so the printed total settles it rather than a convention we chose. ROWS ARE KEYED BY PRINTED POSITION, NOT BY NAME. `ENGINEER AND CONSTRUCT SEWERS` is printed twice, `COMPUTER REPLACEMENT PLAN - TECHNOLOGY DEPT.` four times and `POLICE CRUISERS - POLICE DEPT.` twice; keying on the name would collapse eight rows into four and the cells would overwrite each other. `fund_number` is the row's ordinal down the page, 01 to 34, and `fund_name` carries the article heading the row sits under followed by the printed purpose, so each key is unique on this page. A cell left blank in the expended column is recorded as no value at all, not as zero -- eleven rows print nothing there and their balance equals their appropriation.
